page.overview:
What is Toy Animatronics?

The Toy animatronics are improved versions of the original animatronics, designed by Fazbear Entertainment to replace the Withered animatronics for the re-opening of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza in November 1987.

The Toy animatronics debut in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as the main antagonists, along with the Withered animatronics. They later appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Five Nights at Freddy's 4, and Security Breach as cameos. They returned in Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, and Special Delivery as prominent antagonists. They've also appeared in the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Toys, those being in Five Nights at Candy's and POPGOES.

Hence their name, their suit material appears to be made of plastic, as if they were a life-sized toy. While all models notably sport round rosy cheeks, the Toy animatronics are based on the original cast and have bigger eyes, fully functional fingers, wedge-shaped feet, eyelashes, and facial appearances reminiscent of a ventriloquist doll.

Similar to the old Withered animatronics, most of the Toys share the same endoskeleton, which is Endo-02, however, none of them are visibly seen except for Mangle. Three notable exceptions are Balloon Boy and JJ, who have unique endoskeletons, and the Puppet.
